name: Rust
ffi: plain `extern "C"` blocks (standard library only, no crates)
needs: Rust 1.60 or newer with cargo and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: No crates are needed. `build.rs` links against `libpeep.so` in this folder and sets an rpath to it.
On Windows you also need an import library (`peep.lib`) for `peep.dll`; this binding was only run on Linux.
`read` returns a slice of at most 4096 frames and is valid until the next call.
files: links against the shared library in this folder
demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
